preview.summary: Tactile focal frames that make complex collaborative work feel clear and inviting.
preview.intendedFit: Collaborative SaaS, creative tools, education, workflow builders, and approachable business software

signature.label: Form 08
signature.headline: Turn complex work into something people can see, hold, and move forward.

mark.label: Three rounded cobalt forms orbiting a useful central object

semanticColorUsage.background: The warm open field behind navigation, focal frames, and product content.
semanticColorUsage.foreground: Primary copy, decisive statements, strong labels, and meaningful symbols.
semanticColorUsage.card: A single useful object, task, dialog, or independent proof set.
semanticColorUsage.muted: Supporting bands, inactive regions, skeletons, and calm contextual frames.
semanticColorUsage.mutedForeground: Explanation, metadata, helper copy, timestamps, and lower priority information.
semanticColorUsage.border: Visible control boundaries, object edges, data groups, and structural separators.
semanticColorUsage.primary: The next action, current path, selected state, and purposeful form orbit cue.
semanticColorUsage.primaryForeground: Readable text and icons placed directly on the cobalt primary.
semanticColorUsage.destructive: Irreversible loss, failed requirements, and destructive confirmation.
semanticColorUsage.success: Verified completion and positive outcomes paired with explicit text.
semanticColorUsage.warning: Conditions requiring attention before work can continue safely.
semanticColorUsage.info: Neutral guidance, educational context, and informative status.
semanticColorUsage.ring: Persistent keyboard focus around every interactive component.

display.usage: Product promises, major page statements, and one leading outcome.

section.usage: Section statements, frame titles, and important grouped work.

body.usage: Explanation, navigation, forms, settings, and sustained product reading.

label.usage: Form orbit captions, steps, status, timestamps, units, and compact categories.

metric.usage: Measured progress and values with explicit units and context.

code.usage: Commands, machine values, identifiers, durations, and source text.

1.usage: Tiny object details, orbit relationships, and icon alignment.

2.usage: Inline labels, metadata, and compact control groups.

4.usage: Default field rhythm and related actions.

6.usage: Controls, card internals, and form groups.

8.usage: Useful object padding and distinct task groups.

12.usage: Section groups and compact frame transitions.

16.usage: Major product sections and generous object separation.

24.usage: Focal frame padding and high impact transitions.

32.usage: Marketing introductions and singular spatial statements.

layout.guidance: Place one useful object at the center of each focal frame, align its context nearby, and leave the surrounding ivory field open.

mobile.guidance: Stack statements, objects, and actions in source order with a labelled compact navigation trigger.

tablet.guidance: Collapse secondary navigation and move contextual objects below the principal statement when width becomes awkward.

desktop.guidance: Use twelve columns for a leading statement, one central object, useful asymmetry, and a ranked action.

zoom.guidance: Let navigation, labels, objects, tables, and actions wrap or reflow without clipping.

reflow.guidance: Preserve complete source ordered frames and use labelled overflow only for irreducible data comparison.

compact.usage: Tags, compact controls, and small status objects.

control.usage: Buttons, fields, menus, and ordinary interactions.

card.usage: Cards, dialogs, and useful bounded objects.

frame.usage: Major sections, marketing moments, and focal product frames.

quiet.usage: Large frames, supporting groups, and subtle separation.

default.usage: Controls, cards, tables, and ordinary boundaries.

focus.usage: Focus, active selection, and consequential separation.

flat.usage: Default fields, tables, and large focal frames.

raised.usage: A singular focal card, temporary menu, or movable object.

overlay.usage: Dialogs and temporary content above the product field.

buttons.guidance: Use one filled cobalt action per decision frame and keep secondary actions calm, direct, and stable.

states.default: Use the cobalt primary with an outcome focused label.
states.hover: Deepen cobalt without changing control size or position.
states.focus: Show the semantic focus ring outside the rounded control boundary.
states.active: Compress by at most one pixel without shifting nearby content.
states.disabled: Keep the action readable and expose the unmet prerequisite.
states.loading: Retain the action label beside a visible progress indicator.
states.success: Name the completed outcome with text and the success role.
states.error: Name the failed operation and recovery with destructive semantics.

links.guidance: Use specific destinations, persistent prose underlines, and explicit current navigation.

states.default: Underline prose destinations and use the accessible primary role.
states.hover: Strengthen the underline without changing line height.
states.focus: Frame the link with the same semantic focus ring as controls.
states.active: Preserve the destination while showing immediate activation.
states.disabled: Render unavailable destinations as explained text rather than links.
states.loading: Keep the destination label and add adjacent busy status.
states.success: Confirm the local navigation result in nearby text.
states.error: Explain the local failure and recovery without relying on color.

forms.guidance: Group fields by decision, keep help persistent, and place validation in the same reading path.
forms.help: The selected team receives the brief and the next assigned action.
forms.error: Choose a team that can accept new project work.
forms.success: The handoff is complete and the team has been notified.

inputs.textareaPlaceholder: Describe the goal, constraints, and next useful move.
inputs.guidance: Keep labels visible, use generous control height, and reserve stable space for help and validation.

cards.title: Launch brief
cards.description: A useful object combines the goal, owner, current state, and next valid action.
cards.guidance: Use a card for one independent object or proof set, not merely to add rounded corners.

panels.title: Project workspace
panels.description: The frame places current work, useful context, and the next action in one readable composition.
panels.guidance: Use one focal frame and shared alignment instead of a separate container for every value.

navigation.label: Workspace sections
navigation.guidance: Name the current section in text, preserve source order, and keep every destination keyboard reachable.

listItems.title: Launch plan moved to review
listItems.description: The goal, owner, and acceptance notes remain attached.

listItems.title: Learning path is ready to share
listItems.description: All required modules have complete descriptions.

listItems.title: Community guide needs an owner
listItems.description: Assign a collaborator before the next publishing step.

dataDisplay.guidance: Keep entity, state, owner, freshness, and the next action aligned in one readable object.
dataDisplay.overflowGuidance: At narrow widths, preserve row headings and use a labelled keyboard reachable scroll region only when comparison requires it.

badges.label: In progress
badges.meaning: Work is active and has a clear next step.

badges.label: Complete
badges.meaning: The named outcome has been verified.

badges.label: Needs review
badges.meaning: A person must review the object before work continues.

badges.label: Blocked
badges.meaning: The object cannot proceed until the named failure is resolved.

alerts.title: Project brief is ready
alerts.description: Required context is complete and the next owner can begin.

alerts.title: One handoff needs attention
alerts.description: Choose an available team before moving the project forward.

states.loading: Keep useful content visible and label the object that is refreshing.
states.empty: Name the absent object, explain why it matters, and offer the first valid action.
states.filteredEmpty: Keep filter context visible and provide a direct reset.
states.error: Name the failed operation, preserve entered work, and provide recovery.
states.success: Confirm the completed result beside its originating action.
states.disabled: Explain the unmet condition without relying on low opacity.
states.destructive: Repeat the named object, scope, consequence, and true recovery status.

feedback.guidance: Attach feedback to the useful object or action it describes and reserve stable space for change.
feedback.nonColorGuidance: Pair every color with text, icon, position, or structure so meaning survives without color.

dialogs.title: Move project to review
dialogs.description: Review the owner, required context, and next action before changing the project state.
dialogs.guidance: Name the purpose, trap focus, expose a safe cancellation path, and keep consequences explicit.
dialogs.escapeBehavior: Escape closes the dialog without changing the project and returns focus to its opener.
dialogs.focusRestoration: Return focus to the action that opened the dialog and announce the resulting state when confirmed.

destructiveActions.consequence: Deleting this workspace removes its briefs, assignments, and activity for every collaborator.
destructiveActions.recoverability: This preview action is reversible and changes only local specimen state.
destructiveActions.guidance: Separate irreversible actions from routine settings and repeat object, scope, consequence, and recovery truth.

motion.guidance: Use short tactile motion to connect actions with useful objects; never animate merely to decorate the field.

reducedMotion.guidance: Remove translation, rotation, scaling, smooth scrolling, and nonessential fades while preserving labels, focus, and every state change.

accessibility.semantics: Use native landmarks, headings, lists, controls, forms, dialogs, tables, and status regions before ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Keep navigation, filtering, selection, menus, overflow regions, row actions, and dialogs operable in logical source order.
accessibility.focus: Show a persistent two pixel semantic ring with separation from every control boundary.
accessibility.contrast: Measure text, controls, boundaries, status, meaningful graphics, and focus in light and dark schemes.
accessibility.targetSize: Provide at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels with adequate spacing and prefer 44 by 44 for primary touch actions.
accessibility.zoom: Support 200 percent page zoom and 400 percent browser zoom without loss of content or control access.
accessibility.reflow: Reflow at 320 CSS pixels without page level horizontal scrolling or hidden actions.
accessibility.forcedColors: Preserve control boundaries, focus, selected state, and meaningful object structure in forced colors.
accessibility.statusCommunication: Announce meaningful asynchronous outcomes deliberately without stealing focus or repeating static content.

productSurfaces.guidance: Place one useful object at the center of every surface, align context nearby, and keep the next valid action unmistakable.

marketing.title: A product people want to move through
marketing.description: Lead with one plain outcome inside a generous focal frame, then show proof as tangible objects.
elements: Useful proof objects with supplied claims
Closing frame with one next step

authentication.title: A welcoming way back in
authentication.description: Use one calm task card with persistent labels, recovery, and stable submission feedback.

onboarding.title: A short path into useful work
onboarding.description: Show completed, current, optional, and upcoming steps as a clear object sequence.

dashboard.title: Current work before decoration
dashboard.description: Lead with the object that needs attention, then align progress, ownership, and next actions.

table.title: Projects remain tangible at scale
table.description: Keep entity, state, owner, freshness, and action aligned with readable row relationships.

form.title: Decisions grouped into calm frames
form.description: Group fields by purpose and preserve dirty, saving, saved, conflict, and failed states.

settings.title: Scope and consequence stay clear
settings.description: Name whether each value affects the person, workspace, or organization.

states.title: Every interruption has a next move
states.description: Keep surrounding context visible while naming the affected object and recovery.

evidencePresentation.preview: The Design System Preview is a public visual and descriptive specimen of the evaluated Playform direction.
evidencePresentation.designContract: The complete Design Contract is the public raw Markdown installed into a Project.
evidencePresentation.evaluation: Evaluation metadata and raw evidence paths remain public so Playform coverage can be inspected.
